question:
Identify the spelling error in the given sentence and select the option that rectifies the error.

He dared to compeete against the experienced boxer.
solution:
The correct answer is "**compete**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **In the given sentence, the word "compeete" is spelled incorrectly.**
 
• **The correct spelling of the word is "compete."**
 
• The error in the sentence is the missing "e" in "compete."
 
 
• "Compete" means to take part in a contest or competition.(स्पर्धा करना)
 
 
 
• The correct sentence would be "He dared to compete against the experienced boxer."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.
